info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Rail Operations Status API
info.description: The Payment Rail Operations Status API provides real-time status updates for various payment rail operations within the banking system. This API allows clients to check the current state of payment transactions, facilitating efficient tracking and management of payments. Typical consumers include banking applications and payment processors seeking to enhance transaction visibility. It is essential for ensuring timely updates and transparency in payment operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of payment rail operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest status of payment rail operations, providing insights into their operational health and any issues that may have arisen.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to request the status of payment rail operations. It should contain all necessary information to retrieve the current status accurately.

200.description: The request was successful and the current status of payment rail operations is returned.

GetPaymentRailStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of payment rail operations in the system. This string value indicates the current state of operations as part of the API request body.
